reasons.authored-starter: A starter holds nothing but what its person places in it and costs nothing to make, so the policy does not count starters.
reasons.generated: A workspace may hold three generated worlds. Each is made from a reviewed recipe that states its own tile count, at most four (exulanica/world/world_recipes.py, TILES_MAXIMUM), and each tile is baked once, off the request. No route deletes a world, so this limit times that maximum, twelve tiles, bounds every bake a workspace can cause; a route that deletes worlds reopens that bound. Generated worlds are therefore bounded here and by the recipes, not by the workspace tile quota, and a browser session holds no tiles.materialise.
reasons.personal-source: One world is composed from a workspace's own photographs and other personal sources: code that means that world resolves it from the registry, and a second is another version of this policy.
